elements.description: The table lists low-income and middle-income countries, with the middle-income list continuing across three columns. Italics identify IDA-only countries as of July 1, 2026.
elements.notes: Source: World Bank Group. Note: Low-income countries are those with a GNI per capita of US$1,175 or less in 2025. Middle-income countries are those with a GNI per capita equal to or more than US$1,176 but equal to or less than US$14,375. Italicized countries are IDA-only countries as of July 1, 2026; IDA-only excludes blend and IBRD countries. Guyana was classified as a high-income country as of July 1, 2025, so it does not appear in this table or in the low- and middle-income countries’ aggregates; however, as an IDA-only country, its data are included in this report. FY = fiscal year; GNI = gross national income; IBRD = International Bank for Reconstruction and Development; IDA = International Development Association.
